title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Kambarata 1 Hydropower Plant Project

description.narrative: The project will help advance the preparation of the Kambarata 1 hydropower plant so that it is ready to be financed by interested financiers and donors. The project will support activities in these areas as described below. Component 1 is expected to update the technical and economic feasibility which will identify the gaps in the previous studies, carry out additional activities as needed, possibly including physical modelling, surveys, site investigation and laboratory testing required, confirming and finalizing the selection of dam type to bring the feasibility study up-to-date and make it “bankable” and also additional work required prior to preparation of the tender documents. Component 2 will review the existing environmental and social studies, conducting additional activities including biodiversity study as required, carry out consultation with different stakeholders and updating the environmental and social documents to meet World Bank's ESF requirements. The component will also help design an implementable benefit sharing mechanism with local community to ensure equitable and sustainable development and implementation over the long-term period. Component 3 will further support the assessment and selection of financing options, including equity investors, commercial, bilateral and multilateral debt financing, and assist in reviewing and proposing benefit and risk sharing arrangement among various stakeholders. The proposed TA project is aligned with the overarching goal of the Country Partnership Framework (CPF) 2019–22 (Report No. 130399-KG) to promote diversified, export-oriented, inclusive, sustainable growth, focusing on conditions for private sector investment. It is also aligned with the CPF 2024–2028 that is currently being developed.
To assess the Kambarata 1 hydropower plant project's technical feasibility, enhance its environmental and social sustainability, and strengthen its financial and commercial frameworks.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I. A. 1. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient, through the MoE, shall be responsible for overall Projectimplementation and maintain throughout Project implementation a PMO to be responsible for performing key project managementfunctions, including coordination, fiduciary, monitoring and evaluation, social and environmental standards management andreporting functions, with mandates, functions, responsibilities, structures, resources and staff, all as further described in thePOM and acceptable to the Association. To this end and without limitation to the generality of the forgoing, the Recipient, throughthe MoE, shall (i) hire a procurement specialist; and (ii) no later than 1 months after the Effective Date, hire a an occupationaland health safety specialist, an environmental specialist and a social specialist, all with qualifications, experience and terms ofreference satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I. A. 2. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient, through the MoE, shall no later than 3 months after theEffective Date, establish, and thereafter maintain throughout Project implementation, an independent environmental and social panelof experts to support the preparation of environmental and social instruments for the Kambarata 1 HPP, with experts withqualifications, experience and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I. A. 3. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient, through the MoE, shall no later than 3 months after theEffective Date, establish, and thereafter maintain throughout Project implementation, an independent dam safety panel of experts toadvise on matters related to dam safety for the Kambarata 1 HPP, with experts with qualifications, experience and terms ofreference satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I. B. 1. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient, through MoE, shall ensure that the Project is carried outin accordance with the POM, setting forth rules, methods, guidelines, and procedures for the carrying out of the Project,including, inter alia: (a) detailed description of Project and institutional arrangements for implementing the Project (includingthe roles and responsibilities and communication channels and modes between the PMO and beneficiary state agencies and entities);(b) monitoring, evaluation, reporting, and governance procedures for the Project; and (c) overall disbursement, financialmanagement, reporting, planning, budgeting, internal controls, flow of funds, auditing and procurement procedures for the Project.

Schedule 2, Section I. C. 1. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient shall ensure that the Project is carried out in accordancewith the Environmental and Social Standards, in a manner acceptable to the Association.
